metadata.title: Transfer of neural ensemble temperature post-processing to unobserved stations: random and spatially blocked evaluation — research code and reproducibility materials
metadata.description: Research code, staged working plans, aggregate results and audit records for random and spatially blocked evaluation of temperature post-processing. The manuscript and journal submission package are not part of this record. Original observations are supplied separately by their data providers under their licences. Preserved per-seed prediction checksums are in prediction_manifests/. The archive shards are GitHub Release assets of tag v1.1.0-original-predictions, not files stored in Git. No new experiments were performed for this code snapshot.
